teaser: Cheap, deep AI security review gives open source the eyeballs it never had; with sovereignty and paid maintenance, all point at the least code in production.
core_idea: Open source and proprietary software had no clear security winner because open source had visibility without paid review and proprietary had budget and the cover of being hidden; model-driven review makes deep attention cheap and repeatable, which helps open source far more, as curl's year shows with noise, then hundreds of real fixes, a quiet frontier scan and deeper tools finding more; with sovereignty requiring open code and schemas and a business model of maintaining each customer's minimal version, secure, sovereign and paid-for converge on running the least code in production.
